description: SecretsVault dashboard frontend (vanilla TypeScript, no framework). Built output: ui/dist, served by the Tauri shell.
name: secretsvault-dashboard-ui

scripts.build: rm -rf ui/dist ui/.test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp ui/index.html ui/styles.css ui/favicon.svg ui/favicon.ico ui/dist/
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ui/.test-dist/tests/*.test.js
